environment: https://synthgraph.dev (production), after the deploy of PRs 167 to 171, built-in browser pane, signed-in user, Phase 1 experiment (3 runs, 16 generations). Read-only: nothing was changed on the site.
scope: Verification of the metric-semantics and wording fixes (167), the backend reproducibility assessment (168), the duplicate-parameters removal (169) and the Overview and Parameters changes (171).

reproductionTab.reading: The backend assessment is live and the frontend displays it. The numbers match what production showed when the frontend computed them.

rawManifest.reading: The manifest the raw view shows has its parameters back in their original position, with the full source.

pagePayload.method: Page fetched with the RSC header, 8 fetches 1.3 s apart.
pagePayload.caveat: The 'before' figures were measured on the ?tab=reproduction URL and the 'after' figures on ?tab=overview. The data the page carries is the same for both, but the tab's own output differs by a few KB (about 5 KB on a local build), so the 46 KB difference is not exact. A local before-and-after build of the same page measured 40.9 KB (7.8%).

metricSemantics.stillGuessedFromNames: Examples of verdicts that are still name-based guesses: training/entropy_loss rising shows orange; falling reward terms such as eval/episode_reward/pose show orange. Declared direction metadata (registry ARCH-001) is the open fix.

overview.heading: Flagged runs
overview.emptyState: No runs flagged. Checks run here: failed runs, capture reported as partial, capture reported as unknown, capture never reported and drift from earlier completed runs. Metric behaviour, such as a loss that diverges, is not checked.

runComparison.caption: How each run scored at each evaluation checkpoint (higher is better, inferred).
runComparison.note: The only evaluation metric has a known direction, so the highest/lowest summary for an unknown direction was verified in the training-curves table instead.

notVerified: The Overview rule that flags a run with no reported capture: all three production runs report capture, so nothing is flagged and the rule cannot be seen firing here (covered by unit tests).
The 'Not assessed' fallback against a backend without assessments: production already has the backend; verified locally only.
Server-Timing and the experiment_workspace.loaded log line: in the hosting provider's logs, not visible from the browser.
